messages:
Maya: Random q for the room — if we could adopt one totally silly office rule (no real enforcement, just vibes), what would it be? Examples encouraged. :)
Noah: Mandatory hat Tuesday. Everyone wears a goofy hat.
Priya: 2pm power-nap bell. You get 10 minutes and a nap badge.
Zoe: Silent-5-minutes-after-lunch so people don92t get judged for nap noises.
Carlos: Friday dessert roulette: whoever brings snack decides a surprise confection for everyone.
Maya: Love these. @office-bot can we do a quick poll?
office-bot: Poll created: "Pick one silly office rule" 3 Options: Mandatory Hat Tuesday / 2pm Power-Nap Bell / Silent 5 After Lunch / Friday Dessert Roulette / Other
Noah: Vote cast: Mandatory Hat Tuesday :tophat:
Priya: Vote cast: 2pm Power-Nap Bell :zzz:
Zoe: Vote cast: Silent 5 After Lunch :shushing_face:
Carlos: Vote cast: Friday Dessert Roulette :cake:
Maya: Voted Other ("Chair Drag Racing Thursdays") 
Priya: If hat tuesday wins I will actually knit a tiny beret for everyone.
Noah: I will sponsor a novelty bell for the nap one.
Zoe: Someone should make a simple poster. Low-effort, high-joy.
Maya: Agreed. Winner gets a sign and, if applicable, a tiny award (sticker).
Carlos: Can92t wait to see the hat parade.
Maya: Thanks y92all. Sticker/poster volunteers welcome in-thread or I92ll hunt for the office glue gun.
Priya: I92ll prototype a nap badge mockup and drop in #random by EOD.
